title: Canaoaves & Admin Canaoaves
subtitle: Collaborative Birdwatching Platform in Brazil
summary: National Registry of Birdwatchers. Modular Monolith (Vertical Slice) in React/Vite/TS with Serverless Supabase PostgreSQL backend, Edge Functions, and RLS.
overview: Canaoaves is Brazil's central collaborative platform for registering birdwatchers, scientific expeditions, species sightings, and conservation events. The system evolved into a Modular Monolith (Vertical Slice Architecture) with high cohesion and low coupling.
roleDescription: Solutions Architect & Lead Developer (Tech Lead), responsible for technical design, relational database modeling, and complete architectural restructuring into a Modular Monolith.
responsibilities: Architectural evolution into a Modular Monolith (Vertical Slice Architecture), organizing the application into 11 independent functional modules under `src/modules/`.
Implemented the layered `Page ➔ Hook ➔ Service ➔ Supabase` pattern to decouple business rules and API queries from the UI presentation layer.
Engineered relational and polymorphic database schemas in PostgreSQL (Supabase) for social interactions (likes, comments) and strict Row Level Security (RLS).
Developed PL/pgSQL stored procedures (RPCs) for gamification and analytics, alongside Supabase Edge Functions (Deno) with Webhooks for async geocoding and Resend emails.
Implemented client-side error resilience with a global ErrorBoundary persisting runtime exceptions to `client_errors`, plus an automated Cypress E2E test suite (with automated teardown).

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Migrating a legacy SPA with scattered direct database calls into a sustainable architecture without introducing regressions or downtime.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Incremental refactoring to a Modular Monolith under `src/modules/`, creating isolated service layers (`*Service.ts`) for each module and validating 100% of the codebase via strict TypeScript type-checking and Cypress E2E tests.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Modeling social features (likes, comments, media) across multiple domain entities (profiles, guides, lodges, cities) without duplicating database schemas.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented a polymorphic PostgreSQL structure using generic `likes` and `comments` tables with composite keys (`target_id` and `target_type`).

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Geocoding newly added birdwatching cities without blocking user interface flows during synchronous HTTP requests.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Event-driven asynchronous workflow using Database Webhooks (`AFTER INSERT`) triggering Supabase Edge Functions (Deno) to fetch Lat/Lng coordinates in the background.

11 clean, autonomous domain modules decoupled via Service Layer
Async geocoding and email delivery with zero latency impact on UI

owaspMitigations.title: Broken Access Control
owaspMitigations.description: Strict isolation of SERVICE_ROLE_KEY via Next.js Server Actions for safe Supabase RLS bypass in the admin panel.

owaspMitigations.title: Injection
owaspMitigations.description: Client & server-side typed input validation and sanitization using Zod and React Hook Form.

owaspMitigations.title: Security Logging & Monitoring
owaspMitigations.description: Global ErrorBoundary capturing runtime exceptions and persisting full stack traces to the client_errors database table.
